name: Loop from Trelleborg through an epic stretch of road 746
description: A loop through a short favourite section far from the start rides it once, with no spur out to a corner and back. Found on a real ride (elsewhere): the loop rode a short epic section and back along it (an epic road ridden again stayed cheaper than a plain one), and a corner past it ran out along a road and back (the leg from the section to the corner was never trimmed). Here a random 2.2 km of road 746 (Ruuthsbovägen) between Svarte and Balkåkra, about 45 km from Trelleborg, rated epic: before the fix the best loop rode it twice (4 % of the loop as measured here); now no loop may ride more than 2 % of itself twice.
